title: Lovin' Kale Beet Salad
excerpt: Kids love bright and sweet beets! Try our Lovin' Kale Beet Salad for a tasty plate of greens that everyone will enjoy.
content:
Kids love bright and sweet beets! Try our Lovin' Kale Beet Salad for a tasty plate of greens that everyone will enjoy.

Ingredients:

2 Bunches Lacinato Kale, Thinly Sliced

3 Large Beets, Shredded

Dressing:

4 Oz. Lemon Juice                               

½ Small Slice of Ginger                      

4 Oz. Sesame Oil

1/8 T. Cayenne

¾ Clove of Garlic                                                                                

½ T. Kelp

½ C. Sauerkraut

¼ Bunch of Dill                                              

  1. Process dressing ingredients in high speed blender.

  2. Massage dressing into kale until soft.

  3. Mix in beets.

  4. Let marinade for at least a couple of hours.

  5. Enjoy!
